caption: The drawing is a black-and-white line illustration of a decorative cast iron railing, described as "Rose Design Cast Iron Railing" in text at the lower right corner. The railing features vertically oriented ornate panels with intricate patterns, including symmetrical scrollwork and stylized rose motifs at the top and within the central portions of each panel. The panels are affixed between horizontal rails, which are depicted as lines running parallel above and below the decorative sections. Each vertically oriented panel is anchored at the base to a sloped surface, indicating that the railing is designed for a staircase or inclined plane. In the upper right area of the image, a rectangular box provides a close-up view of a section of the railing, including dimension labels indicating heights and widths ("36" and "14" respectively). The overall composition of the drawing uses precise, clean lines to depict structural and decorative details, with the entire scene rendered on a plain, light background.
title: Cast Iron Balcony
